name: Simon of Cyrene
background: Compelled to carry the crossbeam when the condemned man could go no further.

genericReactions.physical: The wood was heavy. So heavy. Splinters in my shoulder.
genericReactions.testimonial: I didn't say anything. The soldiers just grabbed me from the crowd.
genericReactions.digital: I am a pilgrim from Cyrene. I know nothing of Jerusalem's records.
genericReactions.environmental: The road to the hill... it was crowded. People were weeping.
genericReactions.analytical: I don't know how far I carried it. It felt like a lifetime.
genericReactions.prophecy: I don't know about prophecies. I just know I was there.
